evidence.quote:
* merge with ExecuComp/Compustat BS assumptions;
* pick equilar over execucomp over compustat;
* Equilar(t-1) -> Equilar(t) -> ExecuComp(t-1) -> ExecuComp(t) -> Compustat(t-1) -> Compustat(t);
PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE newlyvested3 AS
	SELECT	a.*, b.*, 
			c.bs_volatility AS lagbs_volatility,
			c.bs_yield AS lagbs_yield,
			c.optdr AS lagoptdr,
			c.optrfr AS lagoptrfr,
			c.optvol AS lagoptvol,

			COALESCE(lagdividendyield, dividendyield, c.bs_yield, b.bs_yield, c.optdr, b.optdr) AS finaldivyield1,
			COALESCE(lagvolatility_, volatility_, c.bs_volatility, b.bs_volatility, c.optvol, b.optvol) AS finalvol1,
			COALESCE(lagrisk_free_rate__, risk_free_rate__, c.optrfr, b.optrfr) AS finalrfr1,

			(CALCULATED finaldivyield1 = .) AS missingdiv,
			(CALCULATED finalvol1 = .) AS missingvol,
			(CALCULATED finalrfr1 = .) AS missingrfr
	FROM	newlyvested2 a LEFT JOIN bsinputsboth b
	ON		a.gvkey = b.gvkey AND a.fyear = b.fyear
			LEFT JOIN bsinputsboth c
	ON		a.gvkey = c.gvkey AND a.lagfyear = c.fyear;
